chapter.heading: The Blessed Fear of the LORD(Psalms 112:1–10)A song of ascents.
chapter.v:
Blessed are
all who fear the LORD,who walk in His ways!

For when
you eat the fruit of your labor,blessings and prosperity will be yours.

Your wife
will be like a fruitful vineflourishing within your house,your sons like olive shootssitting around your table.

In this
way indeed shall blessing cometo the man who fears the LORD.

May the
LORD bless you from Zion,that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalemall the days of your life,

that you
may seeyour children’s children.Peace be upon Israel!
